request.prompt: Editorial instruction illustration in off-white, clay red and coal. The video tile of a white skateboard against a terracotta bank now sits at the center of a vertical frame on an editing canvas. Crisp ruler marks outside the frame, two outward arrows and a clearly lit Expand button show the selected target taking effect. Show newly open sky and clay at the margins. Keep the skateboard complete. Match a restrained orthographic desk diagram with large legible shapes. No text beyond Expand and 9:16. Exclude Chinese text and traditional Chinese visual elements. Avoid logos, watermarks, broken geometry and extra text.
